login_subheading.message: Log in to your Elhio account to allow Guard to access advanced detection models and your personal settings.

login_waiting_subtitle.message: Please complete the process in the newly opened tab.

setup_tasks_subheading.message: Choose which types of images should be automatically analyzed and marked on websites.

setup_task_ai_desc.message: Detects images created or manipulated by generative AI.

setup_task_violent_desc.message: Identifies graphic, violent, or gory content.

setup_task_explicit_desc.message: Detects adult, obscene, or pornographic content.

setup_tasks_tooltip_empty.message: Please select at least one category to continue.

setup_action_subheading.message: What should happen when the previously selected content is detected?

setup_action_indicate_desc.message: Adds a subtle visual indicator to the image.

setup_action_blur_desc.message: Covers the image with a blur effect.

setup_action_hide_desc.message: Hides the image behind a black box.

setup_detector_subheading.message: Choose how the images should be analyzed by default.

setup_detector_lens_desc.message: Offers higher accuracy by scanning the images with a locally running detection model. Consumes more energy.

setup_detector_metadata_desc.message: Checks the data attached to the image. This feature is fundamental and always activated.

setup_verificator_subheading.message: If you want to verify an image, you can have it checked more thoroughly in one of your spaces on Elhio.

setup_verificator_mock_personal_desc.message: Example for a personal space by the user.

setup_verificator_mock_team_desc.message: Example for a demo space with an advanced model.

setup_verificator_error_media.message: This workspace does not support images.

setup_verificator_error_task_ai.message: This workspace does not support AI detection.

setup_verificator_error_task_violent.message: This workspace does not support violence detection.

setup_verificator_error_task_explicit.message: This workspace does not support explicit content detection.

setup_summary_subheading.message: Check that your settings are correct. You can change them at any time in the settings menu.
